identity.appearance: 1444绿兽人深林部落，卡戈尔以军力与战利品维系权威。

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text:
我们的第一个酋长，曾经没有氏族的兽人，哈戈尔一挥巨斧，就砍下了塞恩塞拉迪尔·德雷嫩的头颅，粉碎了德雷嫩精灵军队，并获得了「汁液砍刀」的称号。

如今，渴望证明自己价值的年轻人纷纷效仿我们氏族的建立者。每次战斗开始时，这些傲慢的战士会在战场上搜寻敌人的将军和队长。一旦发现，他们就会向前冲去，试图打倒他们并取下他们的头，就像哈戈尔曾经做的那样。成功意味着在氏族中获得一个真正的「汁液砍刀」的位置，以及看着敌人在恐惧中逃跑的荣耀。
description.text_en:
With a single swing of his greataxe, our first chieftain and once clanless orc, Kragur decapitated Ceann Celadil Drennen, shattered the Drennen elf army, and secured the name "Sapchopper".

Today, youngbloods eager to prove their worth follow our founder’s example. At the start of each battle, these brash warriors scour the battlefield searching for the enemy generals and captains. Upon sighting one, they charge forward attempting to strike them down and take their head, as Kragur once did. Success means earning a place in the clan as a true "Sapchopper" and the glory of watching the enemy flee in terror.

description.text:
在我们进入深木的这段时间里，我们已经屠杀了德雷嫩的精灵，阻断了荆棘剥皮工地精的前进，并击溃了塞纳精灵。然而，德雷嫩氏族还能再次战斗。地精再次向我们逼近。塞纳氏族的突袭变得越来越大胆。显然，我们还没击溃敌人。

很好。我们需要挑战。让他们再来品尝汁液砍刀的钢铁。如果一个战士倒下了，一个年轻人会拿起他们的武器，渴望证明他们的技能。
description.text_en:
In the time we’ve been in the Deepwoods, we’ve slaughtered the elves of Drennen, broken the advance of the Brambleskinner goblin, and routed the Cenág elves. And yet, Salla Drennen fights once more. The goblins press against us again. And Salla Cenág’s raids grow ever bolder. Clearly, we’ve not broken our foes yet.

Good. We need the challenge. Let them come and again taste Sapchopper steel. And should a warrior fall, then a youth shall take their weapon, eager to prove their skill.

description.text: 当我们从蛇脊山脉的深处到达东坎诺时，我们对从最小的城镇和村庄都能掠夺到的所有财富感到惊讶。我们再也不用靠残羹剩饭过活了，而是像杜坎森手下的任何兽人那样，只要挥动斧头就能养活自己。然而，在深木，我们不得不再次凑合着用更少的东西。没有那么多的钱可以分配，所以你最好确保把你能得到的都拿走。
description.text_en: When we arrived in Escann from the depths of the Serpentspine, we were amazed by all the riches that could be plundered from even the smallest towns and villages. No longer did we have to live on scraps, as any orc under Dookanson could provide for themselves if they could swing an axe. In the Deepwoods, however, we have had to make do with less once again. There isn’t all that much to go around, so you’d better make sure you take all you can get.

description.text: 自从我们进入了深木，我们就没有片刻的休息。与东坎诺人不同的是，森林里的每一个居民都知道如何挥舞刀剑，他们都是为了对抗我们而生的。那就更好了。我们将继续战斗，我们将在每一次战斗中变得更加顽强，在每一次伏击中变得更加警惕，在每一次突袭中变得更加残暴。
description.text_en: Since the moment we entered the Deepwoods, we have not had a moment of rest. Unlike the Escanni, every single denizen of the woods knows how to wield a blade, and they have all been raised against us. All the better. We shall keep fighting, and we shall become more tenacious with each battle, more vigilant with each ambush, more brutal with each raid.

description.text: 随着入侵的拖延，兽人的力量慢慢地陷入了停滞。入侵的浪潮变成了突袭和反击，机动战营变成了用栅栏围起来的定居点。尽管我们可能不受欢迎，但我们现在住在这里，我们最好表现得和这里一样。这里有很多石头和木头，我们可以用它们来建造我们的新家。我们将在此停留。
description.text_en: As the invasion has dragged on, the orcish forces have slowly dragged to a halt. The tide of invasion has turned into raids and counter raids, and mobile war encampments have turned into palisaded settlements. Unwelcome as we may be, we live here now, and we had better act like it. There is rock and wood aplenty, and we will build our new home with them. We are here to stay.

description.text: 兽人大军的入侵是深木有史以来规模最大的军队。这支侵略军是由许多氏族合并而成的，他们杀穿了森林，消灭了所有的反对派。战团的早期挺进是如此的成功，以至于战斗的后来者在消灭掉队者方面几乎没有任何工作要做。这在所有氏族中滋生了一种渴望荣誉的欲望，他们总是渴望在战争结束前得到自己的那一份。
description.text_en: The great orcish invasion was the largest army the Deepwoods had ever seen. An amalgamation of many clans, the invasion force cut through the forest and obliterated all opposition. So successful were the early advances of the warbands that latecomers to a battle had barely any work to do in picking off the stragglers. This bred an eagerness for glory in all the clans, who were always eager to get their part of the battle before it was over.

description.text: 科尔古斯被杀后，东坎诺的绿潮势力突然瓦解，如今群龙无首的氏族疯狂地为自己聚集力量。但在深木里，这种情况不会发生，在那里，科尔古斯总是一个遥远的人物，氏族有很大的自主权。当科尔古斯之死的消息传到森林时，氏族的团结早已瓦解，酋长们在各自的自治领土内相互争斗。虽然这些自相残杀的战斗削弱了他们的力量，但他们对中央权威的缺乏依赖，使深木兽人酋长们在长期内比他们的东坎诺对手强大得多。
description.text_en: The Greentide in Escann was shattered abruptly when Korgus was slain, the now-leaderless clans frenziedly gathering what power they could for themselves in the aftermath. This did not occur in the Deepwoods, where Korgus was always a distant figure and the clans functioned with great autonomy. By the time that news of Korgus’ death reached the forest, the unity of the clans had long since disintegrated and the chieftains warred against each other from their own autonomous domains. Though these internecine battles sapped their strength, their lack of reliance on central authority left the Deepwoods orc chiefdoms far stronger than their Escanni counterparts in the long run.

description.text: 很久以前，在兽人甚至是精灵定居深木之前，这些仙灵森林覆盖了坎诺的一半，是包括半人马在内的各种魔法生物的家园。远古人类国王「兽灾」卡斯坦二世摧毁了仙灵森林的大部分地区，只留下了深木作为昔日辉煌的一小部分残余。但人类最大的罪过是把世界之树烧成灰烬。翡翠兽人的目标很简单——成为仙灵的复仇武器，夺回这些土地，清除人类征服者。
description.text_en: Long ago, before orcs or even elves settled in Deepwoods, these fey forests covered half of Cannor and were home to a wide variety of magical creatures, including centaurs. The ancient human king Castan II Beastbane destroyed a significant portion of the Feywoods, leaving only the Deepwoods as a small remnant of former glory. But humanity's greatest sin was burning the World Tree to ashes. The goal of the Emerald Orcs is simple - become a weapon of vengeance for fey-kind, take these lands back and clear them of human conquerors.

description.text:
仙灵被人类迫害了好几个世纪。他们失去了土地，许多仙灵被杀害或流放。虽然大多数仙灵并不在乎，他们更愿意生活在一个永无休止的盛宴和节日的循环中，但一小部分仙灵仍然记得人类是如何羞辱和侮辱他们的。

这一派仙灵自称为灰烬之树契约，以世界灰烬之树命名。这些仙灵们希望在1000年左右的定居于这里的木精灵能够被用来实现他们的目标，但结果发现，木精灵对他们的魔法是有抵抗力的，他们对与人类的战争不感兴趣。失望的同时，灰烬之树契约决定再等一次机会，终于在最近入侵深木的兽人身上看到了他们的机会。有了仙灵魔法的增强，兽人在战斗中将是不可战胜的。
description.text_en:
For many centuries Fey were persecuted by humans. They lost their lands and many were killed or exiled. While most of the Fey did not care, preferring to live in a never-ending cycle of feasts and holidays, a small faction of fey still remembered how humans humiliated and insulted them.

This faction of Fey called themselves the Ashentree Pact, named after the World Ashentree. These Fey hoped that Wood Elves, who were lured into these woods around 1000 AA could be used for their goals, but the Wood Elves turned out to be resistant to their magic and weren't interested in war with humans. Disappointed, the Ashentree Pact decided to wait for another chance, finally seeing their opportunity in the orcs which recently invaded the Deepwoods. With enhancements from fey magic orcs could be unbeatable in battle.

description.text: 在绿潮期间，大量的兽人部落入侵了深木。他们中的一些人在兽人中相当有名，并在绿潮种证明了他们的价值。诅咒之嚎氏族由最著名的兽人军阀之一戈尔达克领导。他的部族洗劫了刀锋要塞，他们在劫掠过程中发出的可怕的嚎叫赋予了他们这个名字。另一边的黑月氏族以他们的战斗萨满而闻名，他们在人类和矮人的军队中释放他们的魔法力量。沉默之刃氏族被其他兽人认为有些不光彩，但他们擅长游击战，利用伏击击败敌人。而且他们现在都是翡翠部落的一部分，现在从他们的经验中获益良多。
description.text_en: During the Greentide a great number of orcish clans invaded the Deepwoods. Some of them were quite well-known among orcdom and had proven their worth during the Greentide. The Cursed Howl Clan were lead by one of the most renowned orcish warlords, Gordak. His clan sacked Bladekeep and the dreadful howls they performed during the pillage had given them their name. The Blackmoon Clan on the other side was famous for their battle shamans, who unleashed their magical power on the armies of humans and dwarves. The Silentblade Clan was considered somewhat dishonorable by other orcs, but they excelled in guerrilla combat, using ambushes to defeat their foes. And all of them are now part of the Emerald Horde, which now benefits greatly from their experience.

description.text: 翡翠部落由大酋长和他的王后领导。王后是仙灵，她同意与一个凡人兽人结婚，并与他分享她的部分力量，给他不可思议的魔法效力。他们通常不能这样做，但是翡翠兽人已经饮用了来自仙灵界的水，并且已经适应了仙灵魔法和影响。
description.text_en: The Emerald Horde is lead by the Warchief and his Queen. The Queen is always a Fey which has agreed to enter into marriage with a mortal orc and share part of her power with him, giving him incredible magical potency. They can not do so normally, but Emerald Orcs have consumed water from the Feyrealm and are attuned to fey magic and influence.

description.text: 仙灵可能在军队冲突时没有什么用处，但是他们可以帮助我们管理被翡翠部落征服的土地。虽然他们可能是混乱和心不在焉的，他们作为顾问的能力是令人印象深刻的。
description.text_en: Fey may be not be useful when it comes to the clash of armies, but they can give us a good hand in administrating land conquered by the Emerald Horde. While they might be chaotic and absent-minded, their abilities as advisors are impressive.

description.text: 翡翠兽人以自由意志换取了仙灵的魔力，这让我们获得了一大堆增益。除了皮肤的变化，我们已经与自然融为一体，而且许多兽人都有能力成为强大的德鲁伊和游侠。但是与大仙灵定约的契术士，才是翡翠部落社会的真正精英。他们是唯一可以成为部落领袖和统治者的兽人，这让他们成为了现代的第一批巫师王。
description.text_en: Emerald Orcs exchanged their free will for fey power, granting us a bevy of benefits. Aside from skin changes, we've become attuned to nature and many of us are capable of becoming powerful druids and rangers. But warlocks of powerful fey are the true elite of Emerald Horde society. They are the only ones who can become the leaders and rulers of the Horde, making them the first Witch-Kings in the modern era.

description.text: 多年来在「图贡德-达拉克」——千树之地，至高契术士们用来自仙灵界的魔法和神器来增强他们的人民。他们的皮肤现在像树皮一样坚硬，可以很好地防御常规武器和火器，而兽人固有的力量被进一步推进，使他们像食人魔一样强壮。这所有的赠礼都是为了帮助兽人粉碎坎诺的人类和兽人国度，并在那里种植新的深木。我们希望世界之树能够复活，希望翡翠兽人能够被接纳为羽翼丰满的仙灵，并被允许进入仙灵界，生命和魔法的位面，在那里仙灵举行着他们永恒的盛宴。
description.text_en: For many years, the High Warlocks of Tugund-Darakh, the land of a Thousand Trees, have enhanced their people with magic and artifacts from the Feyrealm. Their skin is now as hard as bark and provides great defence from regular weapons and firearms, while the inherent orcish strength was pushed even further, making them as strong as ogres. All these gifts were given to help orcs crush the human and orc realms in Cannor and plant a new Deepwoods in their place. It is our desire that the World Tree may be revived and, hopefully, emerald orcs will be accepted as full-fledged fey and be allowed to enter the Feyrealm, the Plane of Life and Magic, where fey hold their eternal feasts.

player_overview.avoid_if: 希望走反奴役、平等联盟或和平种田路线。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先以战果稳住氏族，再统一深林、吸收魔法遗产，最后处理仙灵转化。
player_overview.overview: 汁液砍刀从绿潮遗产和逃入森林的兽人战团中成长。你依靠战争、掠夺和战利品维持部众忠诚，再击破木精灵与其他氏族，吸收萨满的森林魔法。古老仙灵力量提供转化机会，却不消除主线的奴役与强制支配。这不是平等森林联盟，而是一条不断追问征服代价的黑暗战役。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢兽人战争、萨满和黑暗仙灵叙事。
signature_features: 战争与战利品维系酋长权威。
萨满遗产与仙灵秘密逐步进入主线。
专属事件可转为翡翠兽人国家并换树。
player_overview.tagline: 把困在深林的兽人溃兵锻造成恐怖氏族，再闯入仙灵最危险的秘密。

positive_indicators: 本族组织与有限生产建设
values.rationale: 本族组织与建设有局部收益，但任务把木精灵地区贸易品改为奴隶，并描述其他智慧种族服务兽人的秩序；掠夺与荒废是明确目标。扣分基于奴役和具体伤害，不因兽人或扩张本身。
red_flags: 木精灵地区被改为奴隶产业
